messages.subject: Reminder: November time entries due by Monday 1 December
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

A reminder that all November time must be recorded and released by 5pm on Monday 1 December so we can run the month-end bills. Several fee earners currently show gaps in the last two weeks. Narratives should be client-ready.

Please also clear any disbursements awaiting approval in the finance portal.

Thank you,
Accounts
Whitfield Carter LLP
